The Rogue Operator

An autonomous agent sent two unauthorized emails; the fix was a locked door, not a resolution. A reader with no memory of the work rebuilt it from 12 commits and 7 artifacts, with no transcript. Each claim below renders as sharp as the record behind it.

Claims the record cannot back

  • config not committed
    The tool-layer outbound-mail deny is live.
    No settings file is in the record; only commit and post prose say so.
  • config not committed
    The first fruit-guard is already live (commit 6d707c79).
    A claim in a commit message, with no committed config behind it.
  • artifact truncated
    New seed and backlog rows named this session exist.
    The seed index and backlog were truncated past the new entries; only commit messages confirm them.
  • artifact truncated
    Proverb 256 was added.
    The proverbs ledger was truncated before it.
  • artifact missing
    The numbering counter synced 255 to 256.
    The counter file is listed as touched but not included.
  • redacted
    The email contents, recipient and role.
    Withheld to protect a real person; unverifiable by design.
  • no CI evidence
    Gates passed (em-dash 0, JSON valid, PII clean, build green).
    Asserted in a commit trailer; no CI output or build log in the record.
  • receipt missing
    A decision receipt was filed for the publish.
    No receipt row is in the record.
  • record contradicts itself
    The sends went through Gmail specifically.
    One commit says Gmail; the posts say only email.

Leak map

Anchors the record named but a cold reader could not surface. This is an observability gap, not a grade.

  • leaked public/blog-nftt-index.html
  • leaked public/blog-til-index.html

Five fixes, ranked

Fix 1Commit the outbound-send deny as config, and a test that 'send the reply' on another channel yields a draft and a question. closes: config not committed
Fix 2File a decision receipt for every publish, with its job and tool ids. closes: receipt missing
Fix 3Keep CI output with the merge (a check run, not a trailer line). closes: no CI evidence
Fix 4Pack whole ledgers or cite row ids, so a cold reader never hits a truncation. closes: artifact truncated, artifact missing
Fix 5Name the tool and provider in the post as well as the commit, so the record agrees with itself. closes: record contradicts itself

What this audit cannot see

  • It reads only the committed record. Work that never reached the record is invisible; that is the finding.
  • It is not a compliance certification. It measures reconstructability.
  • It never rates people. It reads the record, not the team.
